Give feedback

If you're trying to improve Reels + the path from Instagram to an actual appointment without taking on a big agency retainer, I’d shortlist these Richmond Hill options:

Digital Dash — boutique agency offering social-media management/growth plus creative and web work. This looks relevant if you want someone to handle the content side while also improving the digital funnel.

Platinum Quick — specifically lists short-form video production for Instagram Reels/TikTok/Shorts, along with strategy and digital marketing. 
NewLife Marketing

Metabaz Digital Marketing Agency — particularly interesting for the booking-path side: it does websites, SEO and Meta Ads, and publishes a starting management fee of $499/month. It also says engagements are month-to-month. 
MetaBaz
+1

Mishkat Digital Marketing — offers social strategy, Reels/short-form creative direction, profile optimization and conversion-focused work for Richmond Hill businesses. 
Mishkat

Socials & Stilettos — based in nearby Aurora and specifically focused on beauty, fashion, lifestyle and wellness, with done-for-you social/content production or a more hands-on hybrid approach.

What I'd ask for on a small budget

Rather than buying "social media management," ask for a 90-day conversion package:

4–6 Reels/month filmed efficiently in one shoot.

Reusable templates for Stories and posts.

Instagram bio + highlights rewritten around your best services.

One clear booking link rather than making people DM, search Google, and figure it out.

Booking page with service, price/starting price, duration, location and a prominent Book Now button.

Google Business Profile cleanup so people who discover you through search have the same easy booking path.

Monthly reporting on profile visits → booking-page clicks → bookings, not just likes and followers.

That approach is consistent with what local salon marketing guidance emphasizes: the content needs to build trust and make the next step obvious, rather than simply increasing posting volume. 
NewLife Marketing

My practical starting point: get quotes from Platinum Quick, Digital Dash and Metabaz, but ask each for the same small scope so you can compare apples-to-apples. I wouldn't commit to a large monthly package until someone can show exactly what they'll change in your booking funnel.

If you tell me roughly your monthly budget (e.g. $500, $1,000, or $1,500) and whether you're a hair, nails, lashes, facial, or full-service salon, I can narrow this to 2–3 providers and compare their current offerings.

ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.
